name: one leg quarter squat
description: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.
